title: 2024 Topps #103 Brandon Woodruff Milwaukee Brewers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: Brandon Woodruff 2024 Topps #103 Brewers is a standard-sized Major League baseball trading card featuring the player from the Milwaukee Brewers. It is part of the 2024 Topps set, manufactured by Topps in the United States. The card is made of card stock and is an original, not autographed, sports trading card. It does not feature any vintage elements and is part of the base set for the 2024 season.
